cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the records of all six losses. Our eventual win will look better with a properly documented starting point.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The tournament's over. I was going to clear the team folder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Archive it, don't clear it. Put next season on a new page; the gap will show how far we came back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The team's disbanding. There won't be a next season.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Call the new page 'reunion'. Please keep everyone's contact details with the scores; winning after we get them back together will be worth the extra chapter.
